domains.detection: does the scan still find every surface on the complete fixture and none on the bare one?
domains.checks: does a bare repository still miss exactly the expected checks, and a complete one none?
domains.scrub: does the scrub still find tree, history and message hits by number, and never print the matched text?
domains.kit: does the kit still write exactly what is missing, write nothing on a second run, and nothing in a dry run?
domains.self-audit: does this repository still pass its own checks, and does its tree match no example pattern?

eval.rubric: evals/run.py: golden tasks on fixture repositories built fresh each run (detection precision and recall, the exact checks a bare repository misses, nothing missing on a complete one, the list kind, the scrub by number without matched text, the kit's writes, idempotence and dry run, the report, and an MCP round trip); blocking in .github/workflows/ci.yml on every push and pull request

externalIntelligence.note: the loop reads only this repository and its fixture repositories

proposals.where: an issue titled 'fleet-audit loop: proposals', plus the proposals artifact of each run
proposals.who_merges: a person; the loop never commits and never merges ('ship' means a person merges a validated proposal)
